tagline.en_US: Define and run scheduled workflows from YAML files, scripts, SSH commands and local tasks. Dagu stores definitions and run state in its data directory and does not require a separate database.

description.en_US: Dagu is a workflow engine for operations and internal automation that functions without an external database or message broker. It allows users to define directed acyclic graphs in a declarative YAML format to orchestrate scripts, remote commands, and recurring tasks. The system provides built-in scheduling, retries, dependency tracking, run history, and an interactive interface for viewing logs and execution states.
